fix: exit after run and post so a failed cache restore can't hang the step (#718)

A failed cache restore no longer leaves the step hanging. Previously, a
restore that failed mid-download (for example `getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN`)
let the action finish all its work and then sit in progress for up to
ten minutes, until `@actions/cache`'s segment timer fired or the job was
cancelled:

```text
11:52:31.990 Adding .../installs/npm/12/package/bin to PATH
11:58:04.928 ##[error]The operation was canceled.
```

`@actions/cache` leaves that timer armed when a download rejects
(actions/toolkit#2470), and Node only exits once the event loop drains.
The action now calls `process.exit()` after `run()` and `post()` settle,
the same approach `actions/cache` takes after a restore.
`process.exit()` with no argument keeps the exit code `core.setFailed`
set, and a non-`Error` rejection is now reported through `setFailed`
instead of an unhandled rejection. This holds regardless of when the
upstream fix (actions/toolkit#2478, #2542) lands in a released
`@actions/cache`.

Fixes #717
